rules: A shot is complete only when all eight stage slots are VERIFIED.
A shot is added to PROJECT_STATE.completed_shots only after overall_status becomes VERIFIED.
A shot that fails is added to PROJECT_STATE.failed_shots and retried alone; sibling shots are never re-rendered.
Frame ranges across shots in a scene must be contiguous and non-overlapping.
